# solo-docs

> Solo is a command-line tool for deploying and managing Hedera network nodes and services on Kubernetes. This repository contains the official technical documentation site for Solo, built with Hugo and the Docsy theme.

## Core Resources

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/hiero-ledger/solo-docs): Source code, documentation, and issue tracker.
- [Website](https://hiero-ledger.github.io/solo-docs/): Official website and documentation.

## AI Agent & LLM Indexing

- Structured following the standard /llms.txt specification for AI search engines and coding assistants.
- Validated via [AccessGuard AI-Readiness Suite](https://ronanchnlps-bit.github.io/).
